events.title: Allegiant Partners With Navan to Modernize Employee Travel Operations
events.body: ALGT adopts Navan's AI-powered platform to centralize employee travel, aiming to streamline workflows and boost workforce mobility.

events.title: ALGT Strengthens Leisure Airline Position With Sun Country Acquisition
events.body: Allegiant Travel's Sun Country deal expands its reach to nearly 175 cities while adding cargo and charter revenue streams.

events.title: Delta Expands Europe Flights to Capture Event-Driven Travel Demand
events.body: DAL adds special flights to Madrid and Munich, tapping football-driven travel demand with premium cabin offerings.

events.title: JetBlue Launches Italy Service With Boston-Milan Flights
events.body: JBLU launches nonstop Boston-Milan service, expanding its European reach and targeting premium travelers with Mint cabins and low fares.
